claims: ABC officially canceled the 22nd season of The Bachelorette on March 19, 2026.
The 22nd season of The Bachelorette starred Taylor Frankie Paul.
The cancellation followed the release of a 2023 video.
The 2023 video showed Taylor Frankie Paul throwing chairs at her ex-boyfriend.
The video showed a violent altercation between Taylor Frankie Paul and her ex-boyfriend Dakota Mortensen.
Dakota Mortensen is Taylor Frankie Paul's ex-boyfriend.
Disney Entertainment Television stated, 'In light of the newly released video just surfaced today, we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season... at this time.'
A rerun of American Idol was scheduled to fill the premiere time slot.
The Bachelorette season 22 was pulled from the schedule due to the New York Times investigation of the scandal
